issues.message: Limited layering/positioning signals for visual depth.
issues.repairHint: Use relative/absolute/sticky positioning for hero overlays and nav.
Add sm/md/lg grid and flex adjustments for hero, nav, and sections.

issues.message: Home layout may not stack cleanly on mobile.
issues.repairHint: Use flex-col / grid-cols-1 with md: breakpoints on the hero.
Wrap sections in container/max-w-* for readable line lengths.

issues.message: Hero section lacks a primary H1 headline.
issues.repairHint: Place the main value proposition in a single H1 inside the hero.

issues.message: Hero section lacks strong visual imagery or background treatment.
issues.repairHint: Add hero imagery via HERO_IMAGE, Image, or premium gradient overlay.

issues.message: Hero vertical presence is shallow — may feel cramped.
issues.repairHint: Use min-h-screen or generous py-20+ padding for hero band.

issues.message: Section vertical rhythm (py-16+, gap, SectionShell) is weak.
issues.repairHint: Apply consistent section padding via --section-y or py-20 tokens.
Use rounded-lg/xl and subtle shadows on feature cards.

issues.message: Display/heading typography identity is not established.
issues.repairHint: Wire --font-heading or a premium display font for headlines.

issues.message: Body copy typography scale (text-base/lg, leading) is weak.
issues.repairHint: Use text-base/lg with leading-relaxed for readable body copy.

issues.message: No H2 section headings — weak typographic structure.

issues.message: Muted/subhead text styles not detected for hierarchy contrast.
